title: Malmgren diaries record meetings with Richard Bissell

tellings.quote: I've also seen his diaries, which are now in a safe place and they're backed up, so don't mess with them. And I have seen a lot of meetings between Harold Malmgren and Richard Bissell.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart says he has seen the diaries of a man named Harold Malmgren, which he says are now kept somewhere safe and backed up. According to Coulthart, the diaries record many meetings between Malmgren and a man named Richard Bissell, and he raises them as written support for Malmgren's account.
